title: First Battle of Brega
summary: The English Wikipedia article "First Battle of Brega", at revision 1372213042, opens: "The First Battle of Brega was fought during the Libyan Civil War. It began when pro-Gaddafi government troops attacked the city, held by the National Transitional Council, in the early hours of 2 March 2011." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q989081, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "conflict". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
